3. README.md section "What is not ready or not proven" (about lines 339-367): update only the counts to today's facts (requirements by status from docs/requirements.yaml, open defects by counting "Статус: open" files in docs/issues/), with today's date 2026-10-25; change no other fact there. The "Check on GitHub" section stays untouched.

STATE.md and PLAN.md: record run TRANSL-20261025-01 as done (decisions/0080; 37 roles, 8 workflow files, quality bar, anti-patterns, CLAUDE.md, README, tools/README translated; README.en.md and docs/agents.en.md merged and removed; 37 tests re-pointed and 6 guards restored; 21 requirement blocks micro-amended; the owner's rule: new decisions, handoffs, issues and reports are written in English from now on; reports to the owner stay plain Russian). Keep the existing owner questions I1 and I3. Write the new text in English except where STATE.md or PLAN.md are in Russian already — follow decisions/0080 item 2: STATE.md and PLAN.md stay Russian, new entries in them are in Russian.
Do not touch tools/src or tools/test. No git checkout/reset/stash/clean, no commits, no prettier on .md outside tools/. Before close: cd tools && npm run handoffs-check, traces, npm run check (only the 11 known reds). In result list the changed files.
